answer: A payout is split which means 29% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The lotus schedule is applied in pearl and echo exposes each instalment. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1553 identities would post 4491 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
